ui.ask.advEnglish: Inama z'ibimera zigaragazwa mu cyongereza cyahinduwe muri iyo ndimi (beta).
ui.ask.scanHint: Ngaho mbwira ikibazo cyavutse n'icyo cyabaye, cyangwa se umbwire uko byagenze.
ui.ask.title: Jya wibaza Agri Lab
ui.ask.sub: Baza indwara z'ibimera, ibiciro, imvura n'ubutaka
ui.ask.hello: Nshobora gusubiza ibibazo ku birebana n'indwara z'ibimera, ibiciro by'ibisarurwa, imvura n'ubutaka.
ui.ask.q.disease: How do I treat tomato late blight?
ui.ask.q.price: Mu kwezi gutaha ibigori bizagura angahe?
ui.ask.q.rain: Ese muri iki cyumweru hazasubira imvura?
ui.ask.q.fert: Ni ubuhe bwoko bw'umusemburo nagombye kugura?
ui.ask.q.rotation: Ni iki ngomba kubiba nyuma y'ibigori?
ui.ask.q.help: Ni iki iyi porogaramu ishobora gukora?
ui.ask.outOfScope: Ibyo nzi ku birebana n'indwara z'ibimera, ibiciro by'ibisarurwa, imvura n'ubutaka mu kigo cya Agri Lab gusa, ni yo mpamvu ntashobora kubisubiza.
ui.ask.notFound: Kugeza ubu nta makuru mfite ku birebana n'ibyo mu makuru yanjye.
ui.ask.noPlace: Mujye mubanza guhitamo aho muba kugira ngo mbone uko mbasubiza.
ui.ask.askRain: Kugira ngo ibyo birusheho kuba ukuri, mbwira kuri tab y'imvura niba uyu munsi hari imvura yaguye.
ui.ask.help: Nshobora kuvuga amazina y'indwara z'ibimera nkoresheje ifoto (Scan), nkakubwira icyo ugomba kuzakoraho, nkagaragaza ibiciro by'ibisarurwa, nkakwereka amahirwe y'imvura, nkaguha inama ku butaka, ku birungo n'icyo ugomba kubiba (Igihugu).
ui.ask.disclaimer: Ibisubizo bituruka ku makuru ya porogaramu n'ingero zayo, si kuri interineti.
ui.audio.none: Nta jwi ry'urwo rurimi riri kuri telefoni.
ui.lang.betaNote: Indimi zigaragajwe ko ari za beta zihindurwa mu buryo bw'imashini kandi zikomeje gusuzumwa n'abazivuga.
ui.scan.unsupported: Si muri data yacu kugeza ubu
ui.scan.unsupportedOther: Ibi bisa n'ibimera, ariko si byo biri mu makuru yacu kugeza ubu.
ui.scan.unsupportedMore: Turimo kongeramo ibindi bimera uko igihe kigenda gihita. Saba umukozi wawe ushinzwe ubuhinzi agufashe kuri iyi.

ui.land.sub: Icyo ubutaka bwawe bukungahayeho, icyo wagura n'icyo wahingira
ui.land.noData: Nta makuru y'ubutaka kuri iki kibanza (ubutayu, amazi cyangwa ishyamba ryinshi).
ui.land.approx: Ibaruramari ry'akarere (525 km). A soil test is more accurate.
ui.land.last: What did you grow last season?
ui.land.pickCrop: Jya utera ku bihingwa kugira ngo urebe icyo gikoresho cy'uburumbuke gikeneye
ui.land.why.legume_after: Ibimera by'ibinyampeke byongeraga nitrojeni mu butaka.
ui.land.why.same_crop: Icyo gihe, umusaruro umwe utuma habaho ibindi bimera n'indwara.
ui.land.why.same_family: Urugo rumwe rw'ibimera rufite ubwandu n'indwara.
ui.land.why.root_after_legume: Imizi irushaho kungukirwa n'umwuka w'umwuka wa nitrojeni uturuka mu bitovu.
ui.land.fertNone: Ubutaka bwawe buracyafite ibyo uyu musaruro ukeneye bihagije.
ui.land.fertNote: Indicative amounts. Wemeze n'umukozi wawe w'inyongera cyangwa igenzura ry'ubutaka.
ui.land.source: Hashingiwe ku ikarita y'ubutaka ya satelite (iSDAsoil), imvura y'isi yose (WorldClim) na CHIRPS.
